px.text: Nice, let’s spin up a fresh layer you can actually play with.

First up, there’s “Every film a dot round you.” It’s an earlier prototype with a few hundred films as dots on a single sphere, hanging in your own room. It’s a neat, spatial way to browse your watching universe.
There’s also “Three films opened in one lasso,” where a line around a few dots groups them, and each film opens in its own pane.
And one more: “Glass easels and a dial,” a working room where one dial moves from the focused film, through its stack, to everything.

I’d start with “Open, fill, pull” because it sounds like the most hands-on way to feel the minimap’s flow—open something, see the context bloom, then dive. Next step, we could open that one and sketch a quick trial flow for how you’d move and select.
